config_dir.description: Directory containing LemonLDAP::NG configuration files (e.g., lemonldap-ng.ini, domains, vhost.conf).

session_dir.description: Directory where LemonLDAP::NG stores session files (must be writable by the service user).

log_level.description: Minimum log level for the application. Options: debug, info, notice, warning, error, crit, alert, emerg.

debug.description: Enable verbose debug output. Should be disabled in production.

host.description: Network interface address to bind the HTTP/HTTPS server (e.g., 'localhost', '127.0.0.1', or '0.0.0.0' for all interfaces).

port.description: TCP port to listen on for HTTP requests (ignored if using Unix socket).

https_enabled.description: Enable HTTPS support (requires valid certificate and key files).

ssl_cert_file.description: Path to the SSL certificate file (PEM format).

ssl_key_file.description: Path to the SSL private key file (PEM format).

processes.description: Number of uWSGI worker processes to spawn.

threads.description: Number of threads per worker process (set to 1 if not using threading).

uwsgi_socket.description: Socket binding: either a TCP address:port (e.g., ':8080') or a Unix socket path (e.g., '/run/lemonldap-ng/lemonldap.sock').

master.description: Enable uWSGI master process for better management of workers and signals.

lazy_apps.description: Load applications in each worker individually to reduce memory via copy-on-write (recommended for LemonLDAP::NG).

vacuum.description: Clean up temporary files (e.g., sockets) on shutdown.

max_memory.description: Maximum memory (in MB) a worker process is allowed to use before being gracefully respawned (helps prevent memory leaks).

max_requests.description: Reload a worker after it handles this many requests (prevents resource exhaustion).

harakiri.description: Graceful reload timeout in seconds — if a request takes longer, the worker is restarted.

log_file.description: Optional file path to redirect logs (ensure the directory exists and is writable).

static_map.description: Map URL path to static asset directory (used for serving LemonLDAP::NG's UI assets).
